diagnostic.title: Lekalo diagnostic item v1
diagnostic.description: Closed wire schema for one stable machine-readable Lekalo diagnostic. The discriminator schema_version is lekalo/diagnostic/v0.2.16 and is independent of the product release, the Model/IR/protocol contract versions, the lock wire, and the diagnostic registry version. Every object is closed; unknown fields fail validation.

impact.title: Lekalo impact
impact.description: Closed contract of one deterministic impact and change-radius analysis (issue #16). The impact contract version is independent of the product release, of the Model/IR/graph/effect/diff contract versions, and of the diagnostic registry version. A canonical impact payload carries the contract identity, the exact input mode and roots, the direct, transitive, and mandatory-public radius, the closed risk vector, the affected target, scenario, test, and gate projections, bounded explanation paths, explicit evidence and completeness, and the canonical digest. No physical root, raw source, patch text, timestamp, runtime value, host, locale, repository identity, or adapter transcript may appear. Canonical bytes are compact UTF-8 JSON whose object keys follow this schema order; set-like arrays sort by unsigned UTF-8 of their typed keys; the digest is the SHA-256 of the canonical envelope bytes with the digest field set to the empty string.
